coverage: Buffered attack immediately after normal and Just parry does not replay the parry-success pose or its recovery after the counter.
Left/right impacts retain their emitted world contact and facing after player movement and turning.
Afterimages, transit silhouettes and eye trails copy the displayed art transform once in both directions.
The counter camera focuses on the hero, freezes on Pause and restores its original position and size on completion.
Reset, disable, death, target loss and active-scene change restore camera ownership.
Camera motion set to zero restores the normal view without changing counter damage or timing.
Existing counter phases, damage, launch, stocks, obstacles, common feedback, parry reactions, filming and Studio remain covered by related regression tests.
postTestChange: Only the F6 label was clarified to Camera (shake / zoom); compilation and the displayed Game View were checked afterward.

connectionRecovery.before: Unity was responding, but no uLoop listener was present on port 8701 and get-version reported server not running.
connectionRecovery.action: Opened Window > Unity CLI Loop > Server with Computer Use.
connectionRecovery.after: The server displayed Running on port 8701; get-version, compile, dynamic code, tests and screenshots succeeded.

limitations: Related suites were run, not the entire project test suite.
Screenshots and gameplay progression used the combat clock and action API, not a human play-feel acceptance.
Physical gamepad, 15-minute human playtest and standalone Development Build were not performed.
Existing unrelated uncommitted scene, art, input settings and requirements edits were preserved.
